title: Account Executive, Mid-Market (Berlin, Germany)
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are looking for an Mid-Market Account Executive to join our team of high performing Account Executives in the DACH region. Figma is growing and moving fast. Our next team member will have an agile, dynamic mindset, be comfortable embracing change and a true team-player. You won’t be alone! Figma has an incredible team and you’ll work closely with other groups including Support, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Community. You will report directly to our Commercial Sales Manager who is also based in Berlin, Germany.

This is a full time role in our Berlin office within a hybrid environment or remote. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Build a strong sales pipeline while exceeding quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Work closely with cross functional teams to ensure sales effectiveness 
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within Enterprise accounts
  • Be part of a team dedicated to promoting Figma to existing and new customers
  • Help build the foundation and processes for all customer facing teams at Figma
  • Work with a dedicated set of customers, each with up to 5,000 employees

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of closing experience working with customers, ideally with a SaaS product
  • Excited about working in a fast-paced environment and helping improve business processes as we grow
  • Desire to learn a technical product and effectively communicate Figma’s value to potential customers
  • Ambitious self-starter who’s eager to learn while being a core part of building our business from the ground up 
  • High attention to detail with excellent written and verbal communication
  • Fluency in German

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling to technical audiences
  • Experience with UX/UI design principles and collaboration tools
  • Proven experience using a sales methodology, ideally Command of the Message or MEDDICC
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. 

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

title: Software Engineer - Machine Learning
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Figma is seeking a versatile and experienced Machine Learning / AI Engineer to join our growing AI team, working at the intersection of applied machine learning, infrastructure, and product innovation. Whether you’re building intelligent search systems, crafting scalable data pipelines, or enhancing AI-powered creativity tools, your work will drive user productivity, shape new product experiences, and advance the state of AI at Figma.

You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, designers, and product managers across multiple teams to deliver high-quality ML-driven features and infrastructure. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role where you’ll shape both foundational systems and user-facing capabilities.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Design, build, and productionize ML models for Search, Discovery, Ranking, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and generative AI features.
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines to collect high-quality training and evaluation datasets, including annotation systems and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to iterate on datasets, evaluation metrics, and model architectures to improve quality and relevance.
  • Work with product engineers to define and deliver impactful AI features across Figma’s platform.
  • Partner with infrastructure engineers to develop and optimize systems for training, inference, monitoring, and deployment.
  • Explore new ideas at the edge of what’s technically possible and help shape the long-term AI vision at Figma.

We’d love to hear from you If you have:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, with 3+ years focused on applied machine learning or AI.
  • Strong experience with end-to-end ML model development, including training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with ML libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Spark MLlib, or XGBoost.
  • Experience designing and building scalable data and annotation pipelines, as well as evaluation systems for AI model quality.
  • Experience mentoring or leading others and contributing to a culture of technical excellence and innovation.

While not required, It’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with search relevance, ranking, NLP, or RAG systems.
  • Experience with AI infrastructure and MLOps, including observability, CI/CD, and automation for ML workflows.
  • Experience working on creative or design-focused ML applications.
  • Knowledge of additional languages such as C++ or Go is a plus, but not required.
  • A product mindset with the ability to tie technical work to user outcomes and business impact.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially when working across functions (engineering, product, research).

title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Data Platform team at Figma builds and operates the foundational systems that power analytics, AI/ML, and data-driven decision-making across the company. We serve a diverse set of stakeholders, including AI researchers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, product engineers, and business teams that rely on data for insights and strategy. Our team owns and scales critical platforms such as the Snowflake data warehouse, ML Datalake, orchestration and pipeline infrastructure, and large-scale data ingestion and processing systems, managing all data flowing into and out of these platforms.

Despite being a small team, we take on high-scale, high-impact challenges. In the coming years, we're focused on building the data infrastructure layer for Figma's AI-powered products, driving cost and performance optimizations across our data stack, scaling our ingestion and reverse ETL capabilities for new product use cases, and strengthening data quality, reliability, and compliance at every layer. If you're passionate about building scalable, high-performance data platforms that empower teams across Figma, we'd love to hear from you!

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Design and build large-scale distributed data systems that power analytics, AI/ML, and business intelligence across Figma
  • Develop batch and streaming solutions to ensure data is reliable, efficient, and scalable across the company
  • Manage and evolve core platforms like Snowflake, our ML Datalake, orchestration infrastructure, and real-time ingestion systems
  • Improve data reliability, consistency, and compliance, ensuring high-quality data for engineering, research, and business stakeholders
  • Identify and drive cost optimization opportunities across data processing, compute infrastructure, and storage
  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, product engineers, and business teams to understand data needs and build scalable solutions
  • Drive technical decisions and best practices for data ingestion, orchestration, processing, and storage
  • Mentor and support engineers, fostering a culture of learning and technical excellence

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of backend or infrastructure engineering experience, including designing and building distributed data infrastructure at scale
  • Strong expertise in batch and streaming data processing technologies such as Spark, Flink, Kafka, or Airflow/Dagster
  • Proven track record of impact-driven problem-solving in fast-paced environments, with a strong focus on high-quality, reliable, and performant systems
  • Excellent technical communication skills, with experience collaborating across both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of learning and technical excellence

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with our stack, including Golang, Python, SQL, frameworks such as dbt, and technologies like Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, and Dagster
  • Experience building data infrastructure for AI/ML pipelines, including model serving, feature stores, or dataset compliance
  • Experience with reverse ETL, personalization platforms, or real-time event ingestion systems
  • Experience with data governance, access control, and cost optimization strategies for large-scale data platforms
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, take ownership, and drive projects from inception to execution
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code

descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Figma Research team is hiring a seasoned researcher to support Figma’s Agentic Experiences, and actively shape and execute research to drive scale, tap new opportunities, and ensure Figma continues pushing innovation in design and production tooling. Because Figma is used by so many of the leading software companies around the world, you will be uniquely positioned to advance the state of how product development works across the entire industry.

This work sits at the center of one of the most consequential shifts in our industry: how designers and developers build software alongside AI. That means researching experiences where the output is nondeterministic and “did it work?” is a judgment call rather than a pass/fail, digging into questions about trust, verification, control, and how expectations change as what is possible changes. We are looking for someone energized by that ambiguity rather than waiting for it to resolve.

The ideal candidate brings a deep passion for research and strategy, pushing the envelope with AI led experiences, and laddering key user needs to critical product decisions and broader business impact. Partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering, you will tackle our highest impact problems, influencing company strategy for both the short- and long-term. You will own your problem space end to end and you will be expected to bring a point of view on product decisions. 

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Help Figma grow and innovate by delivering strategic research and recommendations and materially influencing the vision and strategy for Figma’s Agentic Experiences
  • Partner closely with product leaders to identify opportunities, generate strategy, and define success
  • Break down complex business challenges into clear research plans; own the end to end research process and leverage strong storytelling skills to deliver meaningful impact to Figma’s businesses
  • Leverage your product mindset and storytelling chops to influence product roadmap
  • Move fluidly between multi-quarter strategic direction and specific, in-the-weeds recommendations a designer or PM can act on next week
  • Advocate for the role of Research as a strategic partner in the business process, and raise the craft bar around you through mentorship and the standards you set

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in UX research or user insights at a high growth B2B SaaS company 
  • Direct experience conducting research on AI-powered products and features, including evaluating experiences where there is no single correct output and a point of view on how users build (or lose) trust in them over time
  • A track record of owning significant research programs independently, including framing the question, choosing the approach, and driving the follow-through on product recommendations  
  • Expertise in utilizing a variety of research methodologies, including both qualitative and quantitative techniques, to address product challenges spanning from opportunity identification, concept testing, to feature iterations.
  • Comfort with product telemetry and analytics: able to form a hypothesis from behavioral data and partner with data science as a peer rather than outsourcing the numbers
  • Demonstrated success in identifying assumptions that underpin key challenges, prioritizing the most critical assumptions, and creating right sized research approaches to test those critical assumptions. 
  • A proven track record of gaining buy in from executive stakeholders and cross disciplinary partners, transcending mere research mechanics and findings to articulate a larger user story, and the “so what” to inspire action
  • Ability to balance speed and rigor, pivot directions, seek out new perspectives, receive feedback, and seek solutions in creative ways.
  • Ability to balance user research, strategy, business insights, team input, and intuition in decision-making processes

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience researching design tooling, developer tools, creative software, or other products where the users are themselves building things
  • 2+ years in product design, user centric product management, product development, and/or front end engineering
  • Experience partnering with model or evaluation teams, and a view on how qualitative signal and offline evals inform one another
  • A familiarity and depth of experience using Figma’s products

You'll design, build, and operationalize integrations across systems like Decagon, Zendesk, Figma admin tooling, and adjacent Product Support platforms. Your work will help us bring the right context into customer conversations, automate complex workflows, and optimize both the customer and Specialist experience by applying AI where it can meaningfully improve support workflows, quality, and efficiency.

This role is ideal for someone who can move from ambiguous support problems to working technical solutions: understanding the workflow, identifying the systems involved, building the integration or automation, validating the data flow, and measuring the impact on customer outcomes and Specialist efficiency.

  • Design and maintain integrations across Decagon, Zendesk, Figma admin tooling, internal data sources, and adjacent Product Support platforms
  • Bring relevant customer, account, product, billing, file, or admin metadata into support conversations so chatbots and Specialists have the context they need to resolve issues more effectively
  • Use LLMs and AI patterns for classification, summarization, routing, recommendations, context enrichment, and workflow automation
  • Partner with Engineering, Analytics, Security, Programs, Support, and vendor teams to align on requirements, implementation, governance, and rollout
  • Build quality checks, monitoring, fallback paths, and operational guardrails so AI-powered workflows can be trusted in production
  • Define success metrics for each workflow, track adoption and impact, and iterate based on customer outcomes, Specialist efficiency, and adoption

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience shipping integrations, automations, or internal tools across customer-facing operational systems
  • Strong proficiency in modern back-end technologies and languages (e.g., Ruby, Python, Go, C++, PostgreSQL), with hands-on experience building APIs, implementing webhooks, orchestrating data flows, and integrating systems across complex workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-powered workflows, AI automations, or AI-enabled customer/support experiences, including working with operational data to debug issues, improve workflows, and measure impact
  • Strong product and stakeholder instincts: you can translate ambiguous support problems into practical, adopted, and measurable technical solutions
  • Proven track record of designing AI workflows with clear guardrails, fallback paths, and responsible deployment practices

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with support platforms like Zendesk, Decagon, Sprinklr, Gainsight, Maestro QA/Rippit, Assembled, Salesforce, or similar systems
  • Familiarity with agent assist tooling, AI support chatbots, copilot tooling, RAG, AI observability, or monitoring AI workflows in production
  • Experience building internal Slack tooling, workflow automations, or embedded support experiences

title: Manager, Software Engineering - AI Observability
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As the Engineering Manager for Observability, you'll lead the team building the systems that show Figma how its platform and its AI products actually behave in production. That spans our core observability stack, meaning metrics, logs, and distributed tracing, as well as a fast-growing new frontier: the AI observability pipeline that turns traces, conversations, and model outputs into the classification and evals that make Figma's AI features measurably better. You'll set strategy across both, raise the bar on instrumentation and data quality, and push into AI-driven approaches to anomaly detection and operational automation. Observability was an unowned space at Figma until recently, so this is a rare chance to shape an early-stage, high-leverage platform that every engineering team here depends on.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead and grow a 6 engineer team responsible for the reliability, scalability, and evolution of Figma's observability and AI observability platforms.
  • Own and evolve the AI observability ecosystem: a privacy-safe telemetry pipeline that aggregates trace, conversation, and model data, runs classification, and lets teams run evals to measure and improve AI feature quality.
  • Own Figma's core observability stack, including platforms like Datadog, ensuring high availability, strong data quality, and a healthy signal-to-noise ratio across metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Set the technical strategy for the instrumentation standards, libraries, agents, and operators that monitor services across the company.
  • Explore and ship AI-driven approaches to anomaly detection, root cause analysis, signal correlation, and operational automation.
  • Partner across infrastructure, product engineering, finance, and security to give teams clear visibility into system health at scale, including cost efficiency as the team's scope grows.
  • Coach and develop engineers through career growth, feedback, and technical leadership, building a culture of ownership and high-quality execution.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience leading and growing engineering teams in infrastructure, observability, platform, or AI systems, with a track record of delivering reliable production systems at scale.
  • A strong foundation in distributed systems and a platform mindset: you build systems other teams adopt and rely on, not just for your own team.
  • Hands-on depth in observability, AI systems telemetry, or both, whether that means metrics, logs, and distributed tracing, or the traces, classification, and evals that power AI products.
  • Fluency with the modern tooling in your area, such as Datadog, OpenTelemetry, and Prometheus, or LLM tracing, prompt and model versioning, and eval workflows.
  • A high operational bar (instrumentation and data quality, SLO design, incident response) and the ability to set technical direction and drive cross-functional alignment in complex environments.

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Breadth across both classic observability and AI observability, or the curiosity to grow into whichever is newer to you.
  • Experience creating AI Telemetry-assisted improvement feedback loops for services, in particular for AI products and features.
  • Experience improving infrastructure efficiency, including cost attribution, forecasting, vendor negotiation, and usage modeling.
  • A track record designing company-wide observability standards, shared libraries, and agent or operator-based integrations.
  • Experience applying AI or machine learning to anomaly detection, root cause analysis, or operational automation.
  • Experience scaling and mentoring high-performing teams through platform expansion or major architectural change.

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven Voice of the Customer (VOC) Program Manager to build and run a company-wide VOC program at Figma. Sitting within the Product Support org, this role is responsible for pulling insights from across Figma's customer-facing surfaces, Support, Sales, NPS, community, and more, and translating them into fast, actionable signals for Product, Engineering, and Support. This isn't just a reporting role: you'll own the full insight loop, from surfacing and prioritizing the biggest customer pain points to tracking whether they're being addressed and bringing wins back to customer facing orgs and our product partners. You'll work cross-functionally across Support, Sales, Research, Marketing and Product, and leverage AI to move faster than ever. It's a rare opportunity to build something that matters at company scale.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Own the rhythm of VOC reporting and define the mechanisms that feed into the program, including launch insight reporting and ensuring insights are visible, shareable, and easy to act on across the org
  • Surface and prioritize the biggest customer pain points, align with Product and Engineering on roadmap prioritization, and advocate for customer needs – bringing wins back to Support and Sales to demonstrate program impact
  • Monitor and report on customer sentiment from pre through post-product launches, providing recommendations across Product, Support, and Sales on where to act — from unresolved pain points and product gaps to process improvements and sales blockers
  • Set shared, data-backed goals with Product and Engineering partners and monitor progress to help keep those goals on track
  • Work directly with Sales to bring customer problem statements into the VOC program and ensure field insights inform priorities
  • Integrate signals from NPS, Research, Sales, and community alongside Support data into a unified narrative that reaches Product and Engineering swiftly
  • Strategically implement AI workflows to build scalable processes that generate and deliver insights faster
  • Communicate customer insights across a range of audiences, from frontline support to Product leadership, with clarity and a strong point of view

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience building and running a VOC program, as a PM or Manager, with a strong POV on what good looks like
  • A background in a customer-facing function (Support, Success, or Sales – Support preferred)
  • Demonstrated ownership mentality — a track record of identifying problems, driving solutions, and ruthlessly prioritizing when capacity is limited
  • Fluency in AI workflows and demonstrated ability to build lightweight, scalable processes quickly
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate data into compelling customer narratives, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive action across a range of audiences

Our designers are systems thinkers, prototypers, storytellers, and craftspeople who care deeply about quality and collaboration. In this role, you'll turn ambiguity into clarity, push the product forward with engineers, PMs, and researchers, and help us invent new ways for people to design and build products together.

With an eye for simplicity and craft, curiosity for complex systems, and an appetite for technical challenges, you can help define the future of how software is made.

  • Translate technically complex systems into intuitive, elegant user experiences

descriptionHtml:

We're looking for an executive communications manager to shape Figma's story and how our execs tell it. You’ll partner with leaders across the business to turn early ideas into clear, compelling points of view and build platforms that only they can credibly own. From there you'll work with our comms team and Figmates across the company to get those stories told in the spaces and places where they’ll have the most impact.  

A lot of the work is writing: essays, keynotes, social posts and op-eds. The rest is strategy: figuring out which ideas are worth developing, which audience needs to hear them, how a story travels and what makes people excited to share it.

This is a new role reporting to our VP of Communications. The ideal candidate will write and speak with the same precision and clarity they’d expect from the execs they support. They’ll know how to make someone sound sharp in a 140-character post and credible in a 3,000-word essay. You’ll operate with low ego, high conviction and the curiosity to uncover stories people want to hear and that our execs want to tell. 

This is a full-time role based in San Francisco or New York City hubs.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Build the narrative framework executives across the business use to tell Figma's story, and their own
  • Work with our comms team on media strategy, and bring sound judgment to messaging and channel selection 
  • Partner with (and occasionally spar) with executives to sharpen their ideas and the broader point of view behind them
  • Build the system and infrastructure this function needs to keep our executive storytelling consistent and differentiated
  • Find ways to measure impact and drive a culture of experimentation in our exec comms

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Extensive experience crafting narratives for senior executives across formats, channels and audiences
  • A track record of writing for C-suite executives with strong opinions and high standards 
  • Executive presence, and a track record of influencing people who don't report to you
  • Media relations experience and sound judgment on press, messaging and reputation

descriptionHtml:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll embed directly with strategic customers, working across their codebases, design systems, developer environments, and workflows to make Figma’s products successful within their unique technical constraints. You’ll tackle the hardest adoption challenges hands-on, from complex frontend stacks and legacy systems to security and access requirements, while building trusted partnerships with customers’ senior engineering teams.

This is a senior/staff-level engineering role within Product and Engineering, not a sales or services function. You’ll work directly in customer environments when needed, using the minimum access required. Your goal is smooth adoption by the customer’s product and engineering teams, which means making complex workflows work simply in their environment and solving the underlying problems You’ll do that hands-on, often by writing Figma product code, then turn what you learn into a reusable path for future customers instead of taking permanent ownership of the customer’s codebase. Working closely with Figma’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Experience teams, you’ll help shape both the product and how this brand-new function works and scales. The role is highly collaborative, deeply customer-facing, and built for engineers who thrive in ambiguity, take end-to-end ownership, and want to solve the highest-impact problems at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer needs. This role includes periodic travel to work alongside strategic customers in person.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Make an enterprise design system agent-ready so AI tools generate faithful, on-system code: fix tokens, naming, and guidelines, wire up Code Connect, and run evals
  • Get Make Local, Code Layers, and our newest products working in a customer’s real environment, writing code, config, agent skills, and guideline files against their systems and ours
  • Run technical discovery: understand a customer's dev environment, toolchain, and constraints, then scope the fastest credible path to value, in addition to setting the customer up for long term success
  • Debug hard, unfamiliar integration problems (git workflows, CI, dev-environment setup, non-standard stacks)
  • Build LLM-powered workflows: MCP setup, agent skills, and prompt engineering tuned to each customer’s context
  • Turn one-off solutions into reusable playbooks and product feedback, so patterns you solve once become self-serve or shipped product
  • Bring  learnings on friction back to Figma's Product and Engineering teams, influence what gets built next, and often build it

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years shipping production software end-to-end, with meaningful time embedded with customers or partner teams
  • Excellent customer-facing communication and technical partnership skills, with the ability to build trust with senior engineers and translate customer needs into actionable product and engineering solutions
  • Strong engineering fundamentals and adaptability, with the ability to quickly navigate unfamiliar codebases, languages, and technical environments to deliver production-ready solutions
  • Hands-on experience with design systems and design-to-code workflows, including component libraries, tokens, documentation, and the tooling that connects design artifacts to production code
  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, including demonstrated fluency with agentic coding tools (e.g., MCP, agent orchestration). You have hands-on experience integrating APIs and SDKs, troubleshooting toolchains and CI environments, and navigating enterprise requirements such as SSO, security reviews, access controls, data residency, and compliance frameworks
  • Comfort owning ambiguous technical problems end to end, identifying patterns across customer engagements, and turning field learning into reusable product improvements

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Background in forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, developer experience, or a similar customer-facing technical role
  • Familiarity with developer tools, design-to-code workflows, or AI/LLM products, including tools such as Code Connect, Storybook, Style Dictionary, or comparable technologies
  • Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Experience, Solutions Architecture, or related teams to deliver complex enterprise engagements

  • A curious, rigorous, and self-starting mindset, with the ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and translate research into real-world impact

We're product builders who bring research expertise to the team, working closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to clarify problems, test ideas, and recommend what to change—often in one- to two-week sprints.

You'll rotate across product areas, ramp up quickly, and build relationships as you go, energized by unfamiliar products and ambiguous problems and ready to take initiative rather than wait for a fully scoped brief. You bring strong opinions about what makes a great experience, grounded in the needs of the people using it, spot connections across product areas, and combine deep qualitative and quantitative research expertise with a flexible, resourceful approach to moving quickly without sacrificing rigor. Beyond individual studies, you bring a clear point of view on what to build or change, tailor your communication to your audience, and are willing to challenge assumptions and say the hard thing with care—asking for help when you need it and offering it when others do.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Scope and run focused research in quick sprints, using sound methods to answer the questions most likely to change a product decision
  • Turn findings into specific recommendations a designer or PM can act on, working through tradeoffs and helping the team put them into practice
  • Present product recommendations to cross-functional teams and senior leadership, telling the story behind the data, not just reporting insights
  • Rotate across product areas and teams as needed, building credibility and relationships quickly without being embedded long-term

  • Strong product judgment, with examples of specific recommendations you made and how they shaped the product, backed by strong communication and storytelling skills with a track record of securing executive buy-in
  • Experience ramping up quickly on new projects and delivering clear recommendations in one- to two-week research sprints, turning ambiguous problems into clear questions and a practical path forward
  • A scrappy, flexible approach, adapting to changing priorities and tight timelines while maintaining sound research methods, including active use of AI tools to improve speed, quality, or scale

descriptionHtml:

Video is one of the most powerful ways we bring the Figma brand to life, and we are building the function to match that ambition. As a Video Strategist, you will define what video does for this brand and build the operation that delivers it: the strategy, the franchises people come back for, the production model behind them, and eventually the team that runs it all. You will sit within Brand Marketing and partner closely with design, creative, comms, product marketing, community, and advocacy to turn complex product and customer stories into work people want to watch and share.

This is a rare combination. Figma is a beloved brand with a creative community that already wants to hear from us, and a video function that is still yours to build.

This is a full time role based in San Francisco or New York hub, or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Set the strategy: Define the role video plays across brand, social, editorial, product launch, community, and event moments. Own the format architecture and the prioritization framework that decides what we make and what we pass on
  • Build franchises: Create and run a portfolio of recurring video programs that compound audience over time, alongside the campaign and launch work. Own the development pipeline for new formats and the call to renew, evolve, or retire a series
  • Build the engine: Decide what we produce in-house, what goes to agencies and directors, and what we source from creators, with the economics behind each. Own the video budget and vendor relationships, and build the standards we are missing today around briefing, review, rights, and asset reuse
  • Lead the craft: Set and hold the quality bar for video made anywhere under the Figma brand. Write and approve briefs, run creative reviews, and enable cross-functional teams producing their own video with guardrails and coaching rather than gatekeeping
  • Measure what matters: Partner with our Brand Marketing Technologist to define what good looks like for each format and franchise, instrument it, and report it in a way that changes what we make next
  • Grow the team: Lead, hire, and develop the video team and the external bench, and make the case for the resourcing the strategy requires

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 10+ years across video, brand storytelling, editorial, content strategy, or production leadership, including several years leading a video function or team
  • A track record creating and running recurring video franchises that outlasted a single season and grew an audience
  • Experience owning a production model end to end: the in-house versus agency versus creator call, a real budget, and the partner relationships behind it
  • People leadership. You have hired, developed, and given hard feedback to producers, editors, or an external bench
  • Fluency across the format spectrum, from social-first short-form to long-form storytelling, launch films, and customer narratives, with clear opinions on what each format is good for
  • The ability to set a creative bar for work made by people who do not report to you, and to hold it without becoming the bottleneck
  • Comfort as the video voice in rooms with senior stakeholders, including the judgment to disagree productively and the measurement literacy to defend your decisions

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Hands-on editing or motion graphics ability. We are not hiring you to sit on a timeline, but craft fluency sharpens judgment and helps you move fast

You'll create clarity across this system by establishing lightweight planning and governance, aligning teams around shared milestones and decisions, and ensuring initiatives move from intake through release and operational handoff with clear ownership and measurable outcomes — shaping not only what gets delivered, but also how Figma evaluates, builds, releases, and operates internal AI capabilities as the portfolio grows.

The ideal candidate can bring structure to an ambiguous, fast-moving environment without introducing unnecessary process, and can lead complex work through influence rather than direct authority.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Translate the Product Manager's roadmap and prioritized outcomes into integrated program plans, milestones, release schedules, decision points, and clear ownership
  • Manage execution of the Internal AI Tooling roadmap across technical teams and business stakeholders
  • Operationalize a transparent intake and routing process so requests have a defined problem, expected business outcome, delivery path, risk profile, and accountable owner before work begins
  • Establish and facilitate lightweight planning and execution cadences, including program reviews, dependency reviews, decision forums, release-readiness reviews, and stakeholder updates
  • Maintain an integrated view of dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and decisions, driving timely resolution or escalation when work is blocked
  • Coordinate security reviews, legal and procurement milestones, data dependencies, vendor commitments, and business-system integrations so these workstreams are engaged at the appropriate stage of delivery
  • Ensure releases have appropriate acceptance criteria, operational ownership, support processes, runbooks, escalation paths, and feedback loops before handoff
  • Partner with Product and stakeholders to define measurable outcomes and provide clear reporting on delivery health, adoption readiness, operational performance, and realized impact

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex programs across Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Data, Business Systems, Operations, and business stakeholders
  • A track record of translating product roadmaps into integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, decision points, release schedules, and measurable outcomes while maintaining clear ownership boundaries between Product, Program, and Engineering
  • Technical fluency with enterprise systems, APIs, integrations, data flows, platform dependencies, identity and access, and software-delivery lifecycles. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to engage credibly in technical planning and tradeoff conversations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish lightweight governance, present concise decisions and risks, and create accountability without relying on direct authority

title: PhD Intern, Software Engineer - Graphics (2027)
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Rendering & Animation team (R&A) builds the graphics engine which renders the canvas for all Figma applications. Our mission is to make rendering performant, feature-rich, reliable, maintainable and extendible across all products & surfaces. The team plays a core, bedrock role for the company because it underpins the technology driving the user experience, touching many other teams, and as such is one of the most impactful areas of Figma.

The R&A team is devoted to hiring individuals with graphics expertise. We are interested in a variety of sub-domains, including 2D GPU-driven rendering, computational geometry & vector graphics, animation frameworks, anti-aliasing algorithms, shader effects, and more recently branching into video/image processing. A PhD Intern specializing in any of these areas would be a phenomenal fit for the team with a lot of exciting projects available.

As an intern on our team, you'll take ownership of a high-impact project at the intersection of your technical strengths and our most pressing graphics, rendering, or media challenges. You'll work closely with your intern manager, team leads, and collaborators across 1–2 partner teams to deliver tangible results within your internship. This is an opportunity to do significant, portfolio-worthy work that directly supplies Figma's visual platform.

This is a 12 or 16-week internship role that can be held from one of our US hubs (San Francisco or New York) starting in May or June of 2027.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Learn from industry graphics engineers and participate as an embedded team member of the Rendering & Animation team
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMs, designers, and researchers to scope and execute your work
  • Develop, validate, and document solutions from prototypes to production-ready systems
  • Drive projects that apply research insights to meaningful product challenges
  • Contribute to exciting domain areas; some examples: crafting and optimizing shaders for sophisticated effects, investigating improvements to anti-aliasing algorithms, improving media processing capabilities, animating spline interpolation, and more!

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Current enrollment as a 4th or 5th year senior PhD student pursuing a PhD in Computer Graphics, Media Processing, or a related field
  • Experience working with OpenGL, WebGL, WebGPU, Vulkan or Metal and their respective shader languages (GLSL, WGSL) or other low-level graphics APIs
  • Proficiency in either C++ or Rust
  • A track record of rigorous problem-solving through academic or applied research, with experience thinking holistically about use cases and the low-level technology required

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Demonstrated expertise in computer graphics, supported by publications at conferences such as SIGGRAPH, Eurographics, High Performance Graphics, NVIDIA GTC, or Pacific Graphics
  • Proficiency in WebAssembly, web graphics, 2D graphics, performance optimization, animation, geometry, or media
  • Interest in art and design applications
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code
  • Related industry experience via a past internship or full-time role
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience collaborating across functions

descriptionHtml:

As a Compliance Engineer at Figma, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and testing security controls across multiple compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST. You will collaborate closely with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into effective technical controls, evaluate control effectiveness, and identify opportunities to improve security and compliance processes. You will also help advance Figma’s compliance engineering capabilities by leveraging automation, machine-readable control definitions (JSON), APIs, and AI-assisted development tools to streamline control testing, evidence collection, and continuous monitoring. This role combines deep security compliance expertise with technical problem-solving to build scalable, repeatable, and effective compliance practices.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Develop and verify technical security controls that satisfy multiple compliance frameworks
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to translate compliance requirements into effective technical controls
  • Design and execute control testing procedures to assess control performance, surface gaps, and verify that remediation is complete
  • Establish repeatable control assessments and continuous monitoring processes to evaluate compliance effectiveness
  • Translate security requirements into structured, machine-readable JSON definitions to support control management, testing, and automation
  • Build and maintain API integrations and automated workflows to streamline evidence collection, control validation, and compliance processes
  • Identify opportunities to improve control effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and scale compliance operations across multiple frameworks

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security compliance, security assurance, IT audit, or compliance engineering
  • Experience with security compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST 800-53, designing, implementing, and testing technical security controls in SaaS or cloud environments
  • Experience testing security controls for design and operating performance, including surfacing gaps and confirming fixes
  • Understanding of cloud security concepts, including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging, and security configurations
  • Experience working with engineering teams to implement compliance requirements as technical solutions
  • Experience with JSON, REST APIs, and automation, applied to compliance engineering challenges

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience developing JSON-based control definitions, JSON Schema, or machine-readable compliance documentation, and REST API integrations and custom automation workflows
  • Familiarity with Open Security Controls Assessment Language (OSCAL)
  • Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for compliance automation, including experience with compliance automation platforms and automated evidence collection
  • Experience using Git, version control, and collaborative development workflows
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security technologies, particularly AWS

descriptionHtml:

We’re a small, high-leverage team organized around three pillars: Platform & Tooling, Infrastructure & Hosting, and Applied AI Builds, and this role is a key member of the Applied AI Builds pillar.

As an AI Engineer, Internal Tools, you’ll work directly with teams across Figma to identify high-value AI opportunities and take them to production, moving from understanding a business workflow, to rapidly prototyping an approach, to evaluating it and integrating it with the systems and data needed to make it useful in the real world. 

This isn’t a role focused only on building AI demos: you’ll own solutions through production, help determine where AI adds value and where traditional rules-based software is the right choice, and shape how agents can safely take actions across enterprise systems. As common patterns emerge, you’ll partner with our Platform & Tooling and Infrastructure teams to build reusable capabilities that make future AI builds faster and safer.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Partner directly with teams across GTM, Finance, People, Legal, Support, and other business functions to understand workflows and identify high-value opportunities for AI
  • Design, build, and productionize AI agents, assistants, and workflow automations that solve real business problems using LLMs, tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, agent frameworks, MCP, APIs, and enterprise data
  • Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems and data sources across GTM, Finance, People, Support, and internal APIs
  • Build evaluations and feedback loops to measure accuracy, reliability, and business impact before and after AI solutions reach production
  • Design deterministic guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and approval patterns for workflows where AI systems take business-critical actions
  • Build production-ready systems with strong observability, failure handling, security, authentication, authorization, and auditability
  • Identify reusable patterns across individual AI projects and build them out as shared components and capabilities in partnership with our Internal AI platform teams
  • Help define how Figma approaches Applied AI engineering and scales AI adoption across the company

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building production applications, integrations, backend systems, or AI-powered products
  • Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, schema-constrained outputs, or evaluation frameworks
  • Experience taking an AI application or workflow beyond a prototype and operating it in a production environment
  • Strong API, integration, and system design fundamentals, with experience connecting applications across multiple systems and data sources and strong engineering judgment about when to apply AI and when a rules-based approach is the right choice, and experience designing reliable production systems with appropriate observability, failure handling, authentication, authorization, and security controls
  • Experience working directly with non-engineering stakeholders to understand ambiguous business problems and translate them into technical solutions and ability to move quickly from discovery to prototype while understanding what is required to safely and reliably productionize a solution

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • A background building internal AI applications or working in an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineering, or AI Solutions Engineering role
  • Experience with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, and enterprise tool-calling patterns
  • Knowledge of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar AI platforms
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Workday, NetSuite, Greenhouse, or Slack
  • Knowledge of with AI evaluations, observability, prompt/version management, and human-in-the-loop systems
  • Experience implementing enterprise identity and access patterns such as Okta, SSO, OAuth, and secure service-to-service authentication, within Security, Privacy, SOX/ITGC, or other enterprise governance requirements

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Figma’s Business Development & Partnerships team accelerates our company goals by working with partners to enhance product experiences, expand our ecosystem, and drive user and revenue growth. As Figma’s product portfolio and user base continue to evolve, the team plays a critical role in connecting our platform to a broader network of builders, developers, and solution partners.

As a Scaled Partner Manager, you’ll help shape how Figma engages and supports our growing community of technology partners. You’ll manage relationships with dozens of partners through scalable programs that you help define and that connect them with the teams best suited to help, spanning product, marketing, enablement, and operations, to ensure a seamless experience. This is an exciting opportunity to build and scale a program that fuels innovation across Figma’s ecosystem. You’ll collaborate extensively with partners and cross-functionally with teams at Figma to drive meaningful impact for Figma, our partners, and users—helping shape how millions of people experience and extend Figma’s platform.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Serve as the principal architect of our scaled partner program by combining traditional partner management with robust program management to create repeatable blueprints and establish and execute on operational frameworks to drive growth with and through our product partners
  • Manage and support a portfolio of ~50 technology partners through scalable engagement programs that help partners succeed and drive value for Figma’s users
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partner inquiries, triaging questions and connecting partners with the right internal teams across product, marketing, operations, and enablement
  • Develop and operationalize scalable systems such as newsletters, FAQs, and enablement resources to keep partners informed and aligned with Figma’s product roadmap and priorities
  • Drive cross-functional execution with product, marketing, and events teams to spotlight partners across the Figma ecosystem, including Config and Figma Community initiatives
  • Measure and improve partner engagement, satisfaction, and overall program health by designing repeatable processes and clear success metrics
  • Experiment and iterate on new programs that make it easier for developers and integration partners to innovate on top of Figma
  • Champion partner and user needs internally, balancing business impact with customer experience to ensure our ecosystem continues to thrive

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in a SaaS or technology company, with at least 2 years in partnerships, ecosystem programs, partner enablement, or a technical, customer facing role
  • Strong communication skills—you can clearly explain both business and technical concepts to diverse audiences and write with clarity and warmth
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams such as product, marketing, sales, and operations, with demonstrated ability to plan, coordinate, and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously
  • Operational excellence—you love improving processes, building templates, and creating scalable systems that make everyone’s lives easier
  • Ability to properly balance the needs of our business, the partner, and the customer through partnerships

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting developer or technology partner ecosystems—for example, through app marketplaces, integrations, or API programs
  • A background or passion for design tools, developer platforms, or SaaS ecosystems
  • Prior experience managing communications or enablement at scale, such as newsletters, webinars, or resource hubs
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. title: Manager, Software Engineering - Design Systems Adherence
descriptionHtml:

From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As the Engineering Manager for Design Systems Adherence, you'll lead the team building the workflows, tools, and quality feedback loops that help customers create design and code that correctly adheres to their design system when working with Figma’s Agents. This work spans context engineering i.e making guidelines, examples, and documentation useful to AI, agent architecture improvements as well as creating  datasets, evaluators, and benchmarks that show how well outputs follow a customer's design system. You'll set strategy across these areas, raise the bar on adherence measurement, and turn evaluation results and customer feedback into feedback loops that make design quality better.

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Figma's Agent and improve overall design quality. An organization’s Design System is one of the key differentiators of design quality as we can use it to make agent output adhere to their specific brand, products and design language. We are also aiming to solve Design <> Code parity and minimize drift away from the defined design system in both code and designs.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead and grow a 6-8 engineer team responsible for Design Systems Adherence across our workflows
  • Coach and develop engineers through career growth, feedback, and technical leadership, building a culture of ownership and high-quality execution
  • Own and evolve design system context: make guidelines, examples, documentation, and other guidance available to AI as useful, actionable context that improves how it applies a customer's system
  • Set the technical strategy for adherence measurement - including high-fidelity evaluation datasets, quality rubrics, evaluators, and deterministic regression checks that catch issues as Figma's Agent evolves
  • Build benchmarking, tools, and dashboards that help Figma and customers understand design system adherence and act on the results, while tracking visual quality, latency, and cost
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and AI Research teams at Figma to achieve business impact

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience leading and growing high-impact engineering teams with a track record of strong impact
  • Hands-on depth in building AI assistants, evaluation systems, and using the latest large language models and harnesses
  • Fluency with modern AI development and evaluation workflows, such as context management, dataset curation, automated evaluators, benchmarking, and regression testing
  • A strong foundation in software engineering and a platform mindset: you build tools and systems other teams adopt and rely on, alongside workflows that solve real customer problems
  • A high quality bar for customer experience, data quality, and reliable measurement, and the ability to set technical direction and drive cross-functional alignment in complex environments

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Strong understanding of design systems, including components, tokens, usage guidelines, and their integration across design and code
  • Proven ability to establish evaluation and customer feedback loops to continuously improve AI products
  • Skilled in benchmarking AI products across output quality, latency, and cost, translating findings into actionable product priorities
  • Track record of developing shared evaluation tools, curated datasets, or dashboards to measure quality and prevent regressions

descriptionHtml:

The UX Platform team aims to improve workflows in the Figma Ecosystem, with a focus on the user experience at the boundary of different features and products. Our goal is to make distinct features within the design editor feel more connected so that both new and experienced users can move as quickly as possible through their creative process. The team tackles complex core product and platform challenges with real revenue implications, shaping Figma’s product experiences across teams and impacting how millions of people design and build together every day. We build thoughtful, extensible UI patterns that help our product suite feel more familiar and intuitive. Given the reach of the features and experiences we build, we have an exceptionally high bar for product quality and craftsmanship. Most recently, the team has been focused on improving Agent-driven workflows in the design editor.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage and support a team of experienced engineers to build new features that better connect Figma’s multi-product ecosystem
  • Champion a strong engineering culture rooted in inclusivity, velocity, and technical excellence
  • Partner with product, design and engineering leadership to set strategy, priorities, and mission for teams and projects
  • Work closely with cross-functional partners and other engineering teams to build and support a culture of doing great work together for our engineering team by investing in team culture, mentorship, and meaningful work
  • Grow your career in a collaborative and creative engineering community

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience and leading a high output engineering team
  • 6+ years of frontend or fullstack engineering experience
  • Demonstrated leadership skills in building a high-performing and highly engaged engineering team; including a proven track record of motivating, mentoring, and guiding senior engineers
  • Experience building product roadmaps with product, design, and data-science partners

descriptionHtml:

We're looking for an Applied Data Researcher who combines scientific depth with a proactive builder mindset. Reporting directly to our Head of Data, with regular visibility with C-level executives, you'll identify and vet opportunities, lead investigations into critical questions, and build useful Data products, tools, and prototypes.   • Develop and validate methods for evaluating generative AI and agentic workflows, including representative datasets, baselines, rubrics, and evals; investigate uncertainty, bias, failure modes, and real user outcomes
  • Personally write code and build or adapt LLM-powered tools, agentic workflows, models, prototypes, and demos that test scientific, product, and tool hypotheses, using AI-assisted coding and analysis in your work

  • Independently drive delivery or partner with engineering to turn useful prototypes into maintained systems, balancing quality, latency, cost, reliability, and iteration speed
  • Establish reusable methods, tools, and technical standards; iterate with users, drive adoption across teams, and use evidence to improve an approach or recommend a change in direction
  • Communicate findings, recommendations, limitations, and tradeoffs clearly to partners and C-level executives, connecting scientific and technical work to important product and company decisions

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, causal inference, or a related quantitative field, plus hands-on experience in generative AI evaluation and measurement, including evals, labeling, and agentic workflows
  • Fluent programming skills in Python or a comparable language, plus SQL, and a record of independently building, debugging, testing, and reviewing useful software, including working effectively with AI-assisted development tools
  • A proactive builder mindset and end-to-end ownership: experience identifying important opportunities and carrying ambiguous work through method development, implementation, rigorous evaluation, and sustained use by others
  • A sustained record of company-, organization-, or cross-pillar scientific impact, including shaping technical direction, overseeing larger projects, and leading other senior scientists through influence and delegation
  • Strong judgment, independence, and collaborative communication, including experience making recommendations to C-level executives, explaining uncertainty and tradeoffs, and aligning partners on priorities and decisions

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with human labeling, automated judge validation, conversational data, or multimodal AI and machine learning
  • Experience building interactive applications, lightweight interfaces, APIs, or reusable open-source tools
  • Cloud and data infrastructure experience; familiarity with Snowflake, AWS, Dagster, dbt, or Hex is useful, but no particular vendor or framework is required
  • An MS or PhD in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a similar quantitative discipline; graduate research, publications, or equivalent applied depth

You’ll strengthen the team’s model, agent system, and evaluation work through hands-on studies, clear rubrics, and reliable measures of quality that reflect user needs, and your findings will guide model and product improvements.

  • Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize risks, balance speed with rigor, and deliver recommendations that influence cross-functional decisions

descriptionHtml:

As a Technical Operations & Insights Analyst, you will help shape where Support invests and how it scales. Reporting to the Manager of Workforce Management & Data Insights, you will combine hands-on analysis with metric development and cross-functional program leadership. You will identify opportunities across channel effectiveness, education, automation, and product improvements; assess their potential; and recommend priorities based on customer outcomes, quality, capacity, and cost. You will lead the work that turns those recommendations into measurable outcomes.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

  • Identify and size opportunities to improve customer outcomes and operating efficiency. Turn ambiguous questions into investment recommendations, including when to proceed, test, defer, or stop
  • Develop trusted measures, including cost per support interaction. Agree definitions, cost allocation, exclusions, and ownership with operational and financial partners
  • Use SQL and Python or R to build reproducible analyses, data models, and reporting. Use git, peer review, and responsible AI-assisted workflows to develop, validate, and document the work

  • Build adoption and sustained use into delivery through documentation, appropriate data-quality checks, and agreed ongoing ownership

  • 5+ years in analytics, strategy and operations, or a related analytical role, with a track record of influencing operational decisions
  • Strong SQL and hands-on Python or R, working reproducibly with git and peer review, plus practical fluency with AI-assisted tools, including validating their output and owning the result
  • Sound statistical and financial judgment: developing metrics, evaluating observational comparisons and uncertainty, and building basic scenarios that clarify costs, benefits, and tradeoffs
  • A record of delivering cross-functional work from scope through adoption, including aligning stakeholders with conflicting priorities and challenging assumptions with evidence and respect
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication, including concise data storytelling for senior leaders and creative approaches to framing complex problems

title: Manager, Strategic Finance
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Strategic Finance team is focused on solving some of Figma’s most pressing business issues. The team is responsible for owning the company’s budget, driving annual and quarterly planning processes, allocating and deploying the company’s resources efficiently, performing financial analyses, and partnering with teams across the company. The role requires someone who is highly analytical and strategic, a great communicator, approaches problems in a structured manner, and is comfortable with ambiguity. You’ll get substantial visibility, focus on the highest-priority business issues, and be plugged into every facet of the business.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs (SF/NY) or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead annual operating plans, long-range planning, Headcount & Expense planning, and quarterly/monthly financial forecasts for consolidated G&A organizations
  • Serve as the dedicated partner to our G&A leadership, planning and managing our investments in headcount, real estate, IT and benefits to ensure they are aligned with company strategy and durable growth goals
  • Perform ongoing analysis of business performance vs. plan to highlight trends, identify risks and opportunities, and influence executive decision making
  • Synthesize and summarize our P&L and cash flow narrative for executive audiences
  • Stand up public-ready performance management structures across headcount and expense like monthly budget vs. actuals, re-forecasting, and a recruiting commit process
  • Manage and mentor a high-performing team (2 P4s, 1 P3)—providing strategic direction, career development support, and hands-on collaboration to drive team impact
  • Get a bird’s eye view of Figma’s entire business, shape investments in our next chapter of growth, and build foundational infrastructure for the next decade of strategic finance at Figma
  • Bring a builder’s mindset to scaling the Corporate Finance function—identifying tools, metrics, and systems that drive automation and enable better decision-making at scale

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 6+ years of total experience in investment banking, private equity, strategic finance, business operations, or a related analytical field, including 4+ years of strategic finance experience with systems, automation, or corporate finance
  • 2+ years of experience managing and developing ICs, with demonstrated success building and leading high-performing teams
  • Deep experience in financial planning, modeling, and creating data-driven analysis to partner with executive leadership
  • Proven ability to distill complex issues into structured frameworks, build processes from scratch, and develop concrete action plans, with a process-oriented, automation-first mindset and initiative to learn and apply new technology and tools
  • Strong track record of building relationships, communicating with stakeholders across all levels, and delivering compelling presentations/memos to executive audiences

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Background in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment
  • Previous experience in corporate finance or a G&A business partnering role
  • Proficiency with financial planning tools (e.g., Pigment, Anaplan, Hyperion, Adaptive) or HRIS/Procure-to-Pay systems
  • Ability to independently retrieve and analyze data using SQL

As an Executive Assistant to our founder and CEO, you’ll help him focus his time and attention on the work that matters most. You’ll own high-volume, complex scheduling and day-to-day administrative operations, build strong working relationships with internal and external partners, and create systems that keep requests and commitments moving. This is a hands-on EA role for someone who takes pride in exceptional administrative support, brings strong judgment to shifting priorities, and earns trust through reliable execution. You’ll report to Dylan and partner closely with the executive team, EA team, and cross-functional stakeholders across Figma.

This is a full-time role based in our San Francisco Hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Own Dylan’s complex, high-volume calendar and inbox management; prioritize requests across organizations, surface tradeoffs, protect focus time, and anticipate needs as priorities shift
  • Manage executive travel from booking through detailed itineraries and last-minute changes; track budgets, submit expenses, and coordinate purchase orders and delegated approvals in line with internal policy
  • Keep Dylan prepared for meetings by coordinating agendas, materials, and logistics; capture action items, clarify owners and deadlines, and track progress through completion
  • Build and improve systems for scheduling, request intake, prioritization, and follow-through that make Dylan’s time more effective and keep commitments visible
  • Coordinate a high volume of external partner engagements and work across organizations; communicate with care, represent Dylan professionally, and build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Partner with EAs and cross-functional teams to organize executive offsites, all-hands, company-wide rituals, and large-scale internal and external events, owning logistics, content readiness, and follow-through
  • Champion team morale and connection across our hubs; create shared experiences that strengthen collaboration across teams

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 8+ years of executive assistant experience, including directly supporting a founder and senior executive leadership in an environment with shifting priorities
  • Exceptional skill in managing complex, high-volume calendars and competing priorities, with a track record of building systems that help leaders use their time effectively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build relationships and represent an executive with internal and external stakeholders and strong judgment, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to solving problems; you anticipate downstream impacts, balance immediate needs with longer-term priorities, and act independently amid ambiguity
  • Experience coordinating executive travel, expenses, budgets and purchase orders, as well as large-scale events and offsites; comfort troubleshooting meeting technology and AV needs
  • A commitment to hands-on administrative work and a desire to deepen your impact as an EA by building trust, improving processes, and consistently following through and a thoughtful, inclusive approach and a history of reliability, discretion, and sound handling of highly confidential information

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company, along with an affinity for Figma and an interest in learning our products
